content.tagline: A treatment-room formula in a home format
content.descriptor: The consumer side of FAU: the Glow Pumpkin peel and booster drawn from the salon protocol, base makeup, SPF 50+ sun care and lip and lash care
about: Glow Pumpkin is the home continuation of what FAU makes for the treatment room. The company took its professional pumpkin protocol and rewrote it into a format a customer can handle alone.

Alongside it sits the base makeup: cushions, BB, a tone-up base and sun care. At FAU this is a separate block for retail and online, and it is bought not by a salon distributor but by a chain or a marketplace.

The manufacturer is the same — FAU CO., LTD., producing under cGMP as certified by the Korean regulator and under ISO 22716. In other words, a professional laboratory stands behind the consumer shelf, not a separate contractor.
FAU's professional lines — ten series for salons and clinics — sit on their own page. The separation is deliberate: a different buyer and a different conversation.

lines.name: Glow Pumpkin
lines.note: Two items, both built around an acid peel: a powder peel with seven per cent glycolic acid alongside AHA, BHA and PHA, and a foaming booster serum. The company presents the line as a professional protocol rewritten for home use.

lines.name: Base makeup
lines.note: Six items: BB in a tube and in a stick, three cushions and a tone-up base. Most of them carry a stated triple function — brightening, wrinkle care and sun protection.

lines.name: Sun care
lines.note: Three SPF 50+ PA++++ formats: a centella essence, a light serum and a cream. Different textures for different climates and skin types.

lines.name: Lip and lash
lines.note: A lip plumper and an eyelash serum.

tech.name: The 7.0 acid complex
tech.note: In the Glow Pumpkin peel the company states glycolic acid alongside AHA, BHA and PHA. The powder form means the acids activate at the moment of use.

tech.name: Triple function
tech.note: For the cushions, the BB and the tone-up base the company states functional status on three counts at once: brightening, wrinkles and UV protection. In Korea that is a regulated category, and the status is evidenced by documents.

tech.name: Protection levels
tech.note: SPF 50+ PA++++ across the sun care group and SPF 37 PA++ on the base makeup — as the company marks them on the pack.

tech.name: Shared manufacturing with the professional line
tech.note: The consumer items are made by the same manufacturer as the salon range: FAU CO., LTD., with stated cGMP and ISO 22716.

content.exportNote: The company reports exports to forty-five countries. Latin America is nonetheless almost untaken, and North America has partners without significant coverage. The company confirmed in writing that we may present FAU to buyers across both Americas.

terms.label: Forms of cooperation
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished products. The company sees this line primarily in retail and online.

terms.label: Territory
terms.value: Latin America is open. North America has partners without significant coverage.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Confirmed against a specific item list at the enquiry stage.

terms.label: Price
terms.value: The export price list is not published pending a separate decision by the company. Terms travel through Teranova on a serious enquiry.

terms.label: Documents
terms.value: Functional status and the wording permitted in a given market are confirmed at the deal stage.
